description: Accounts Inspection knowledge base (Gaurav, 2026-08-16). Each rule = a deterministic anomaly check the inspector runs after every year pass / before every scorecard. Exceptions go to Gaurav; every ruling he makes on an exception sharpens a rule or adds one. Append-only ids.

rules.name: Incoming bank money booked as revenue
rules.rationale: Gaurav 2026-08-16: incoming transfers (especially large ones) mis-booked as revenue is the classic failure mode. Proven the same day: S$36,500 of Dirk-Jan director loans sat in 4025 Incidentals Revenue - Other via a catch-all rule.

params.note: Flags every incoming statement-account txn whose journal credits a REVENUE account, with booking route + counterparty for judgment. Legitimate customer receipts will appear — the judgment pass clears them; repeated legit patterns earn allowlist entries here.

rules.name: Book balance vs source-of-truth balance, every account
rules.rationale: Gaurav 2026-08-16: our books must tie to the bank's truth per account. Statement accounts tie to the statement running balance; Stripe pockets tie to Stripe's own balance-transaction sums (platform table for Platform; connected-accounts table filtered to the own-accounts registry for Connect/Held-Funds).

params.note: First live catch: 1017 Bank - Stripe Platform end-2019 ledger 9,564.46 vs Stripe truth 7,151.96 (gap 2,412.50, under decomposition).
